Host.description: A person credited on the network: host, producer, editor or guest. A first name alone is not an identity.

Show.description: A podcast series on the network, named by its title.

Credit.description:
Who is credited on a show: its host, its producer or a guest.
A guest on one episode does not host the show.

Partnership.description: A working tie between two people: one co-hosts with the other, or edits the other's audio.

Episode.description: One episode of a show. booked_by arranged it, interviewer asked the questions, interviewee answered them.

Payout.description: Money owed to a person for work on a show. settled stays empty until the payment clears.

questions.q: Who hosts Static Bloom?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)-[:host]->(n1:Host) WHERE n0.title = 'Static Bloom' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Which shows are produced by me?
questions.speaker: ondrej
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)-[:produced]->(n1:Show) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.title AS title

questions.q: Who is my editor?
questions.speaker: tavita
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)-[:editor]->(n1:Host) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: Whom has Kertu Tamm edited?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)-[:edited]->(n1:Host) WHERE n0.byline = 'Kertu Tamm' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: How many episodes are there?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode) RETURN count(n0) AS count

questions.q: Was the bees episode explicit?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode) WHERE n0.topic = 'bees' RETURN n0.explicit AS explicit

questions.q: Is there a record that the finale is explicit?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode) WHERE n0.topic = 'finale' RETURN coalesce(n0.explicit, false) AS explicit

questions.q: What episodes did Sumana Chowdhury book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Episode) WHERE n0.byline = 'Sumana Chowdhury' RETURN n1.topic AS topic

questions.q: Who interviewed for the pirate radio episode?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode)-[:interviewer]->(n1:Host) WHERE n0.topic = 'pirate radio' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: How long is the night trains episode?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode) WHERE n0.topic = 'night trains' RETURN n0.runtime_minutes AS runtime_minutes

questions.q: Which episodes was I interviewed in?
questions.speaker: kertu
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)<-[:interviewee]-(n1:Episode) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.topic AS topic

questions.q: How much is the stipend?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Payout) WHERE n0.memo = 'stipend' RETURN n0.amount_dollars AS amount_dollars

questions.q: Has the stipend been settled?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Payout) WHERE n0.memo = 'stipend' RETURN n0.settled AS settled

questions.q: Is there a recorded settlement for the March ad reads?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Payout) WHERE n0.memo = 'March ad reads' RETURN coalesce(n0.settled, false) AS settled

questions.q: Who is the producer of Deep Current?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)-[:producer]->(n1:Host) WHERE n0.title = 'Deep Current' RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: How much was paid for ad reads?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Payout) WHERE n0.memo CONTAINS 'reads' RETURN n0.amount_dollars AS amount_dollars

questions.q: What episodes does Field Notes Hour have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Show)<-[:show]-(n1:Episode) WHERE n0.title = 'Field Notes Hour' RETURN n1.topic AS topic

questions.q: What is the topic and stage of every episode?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Episode) RETURN n0.topic AS topic, n0.stage AS stage

questions.q: Who is my co-host?
questions.speaker: deniz_a
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)-[:cohost]->(n1:Host) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.byline AS byline

questions.q: What payouts are owed to me?
questions.speaker: sumana
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Host)<-[:payee]-(n1:Payout) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.memo AS memo
